# o1 Labs

> o1 Labs is an AI consulting firm founded by Freddy Alcantara. We help startups and growing businesses put AI to work: we find where it pays off, shape the strategy and product decisions around it, and build and run the AI agents that do the work. Tagline: "Shaping the future of intelligent work."

o1 Labs operates at the intersection of strategy, product, and hands-on AI delivery. Our founding belief: AI should amplify human capability, not replace it. We do not just advise, we build alongside our clients.

Canonical site: https://o1-labs.com/
Contact: hello@o1-labs.com
Founder: Freddy Alcantara, https://www.linkedin.com/in/freddyalcantara/

## Main pages

- [o1 Labs home](https://o1-labs.com/): Who we are, what we do, the four services, and the contact form.
- [Free AI Readiness Check](https://o1-labs.com/ai-readiness/): A free two minute self assessment. Five questions that score how prepared a team is to adopt AI and return a tailored next step. No call required.
- [o1 Clips, done-for-you short-form video](https://o1-labs.com/clips/): A separate productized service. Send one long recording you already own and get finished vertical clips back, captioned and ready to post, within 72 hours. Full pricing on the page.
- [The o1 Labs Blog](https://o1-labs.com/blog/): Weekly practical writing on agentic AI, enterprise adoption, model selection, and the future of work. Every article can also be listened to.

## Services

- **AI Opportunity Audit**: A review of how a team actually spends its time, ending in a ranked list of where AI will save the most hours or money and a clear plan for what to do first. https://o1-labs.com/#services
- **AI Strategy and Product Consulting**: From proof of concept to production, we partner with founders and product teams to choose the right AI opportunities, design intelligent features, and build roadmaps that deliver measurable value. https://o1-labs.com/#services
- **AI Agent Teams**: Small teams of AI agents built around the tools a client already uses, each handling a real job such as lead follow-up, inbox and scheduling, or weekly reporting, then monitored, fixed and improved every month. https://o1-labs.com/#services
- **Social Media Clips (o1 Clips)**: Turning long-form footage a client already owns into short vertical clips for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, so leaders stay visible between engagements. https://o1-labs.com/clips/

## Featured offerings

- **AI Opportunity Audit**: A short, fixed-scope review ending in a ranked list of AI opportunities and a plan for the first one.
- **AI Product Strategy Sprint**: A four-week engagement to identify and validate a team's highest-impact AI opportunities.
- **AI Agent Team Starter**: A first set of AI agents, built around a client's tools and tested on real work, plus monthly monitoring and improvements once live.

## o1 Clips pricing

All rates below are founding rates for the first ten clients, locked for 12 months. Every clip is 1080x1920 vertical with burned-in captions. The client owns the footage and the finished clips outright. Details and checkout: https://o1-labs.com/clips/

- **Pilot, $350 one time**: A one page content audit, 6 clips from one video, your pick of 4 caption styles, post copy for every platform, which 3 to post first and why, 72 hour delivery.
- **Core, $650 per month**: Everything in Pilot, 12 clips per month, a monthly performance read, 72 hour turnaround, cancel any time with no notice.
- **Growth, $1,050 per month**: Everything in Core, 24 clips per month, copy written per platform, a quarterly strategy session, 48 hour priority turnaround.
- **Authority, $2,500 per month**: Everything in Growth, 40 clips per month, scheduling and posting handled for you, channel management end to end, a monthly strategy call.

## Articles

- [AI literacy is now a legal obligation. Most L&D teams have not noticed.](https://o1-labs.com/blog/ai-literacy-is-now-a-legal-obligation.html): Since February 2025 the EU has required employers to build AI literacy in their staff. What is actually being asked, and of whom.
- [AI is taking entry-level work. That is where people learn.](https://o1-labs.com/blog/ai-is-taking-entry-level-work.html): The tasks juniors used to learn on are the tasks AI does best, which breaks the apprenticeship model most organizations quietly rely on.
- [What AI training is actually worth: the measurement problem nobody wants to name](https://o1-labs.com/blog/what-ai-training-is-actually-worth.html): Enterprises are spending real money on AI enablement while the best available evidence says almost nobody can connect it to a financial number.
- [How fast are jobs actually changing? Reading the 2026 data honestly](https://o1-labs.com/blog/how-fast-are-jobs-actually-changing.html): The skills-change numbers in board decks come from employer opinion surveys. Payroll and job-posting data say something narrower, and more useful.
- [Agentic AI, explained for teams that actually ship](https://o1-labs.com/blog/agentic-ai-explained-for-teams.html): A plain-English guide to what agents are, where they help, and where they do not.
- [Why most enterprise AI pilots stall, and how to get past it](https://o1-labs.com/blog/why-enterprise-ai-pilots-stall.html): Most companies can build an AI pilot. Far fewer get it into daily use. Where AI initiatives quietly die, and the moves that get them across the line.
- [Gemini or Claude? A practical way to choose](https://o1-labs.com/blog/gemini-or-claude-how-to-choose.html): A framework for matching Gemini, Claude, and others to the actual work a team needs done, instead of asking which model is best.

## Who we serve

Startups and growing businesses that know AI could save them real time, but do not have someone in-house to build it and keep it running. We usually work with founders, operators and product leaders. o1 Clips specifically serves consultants, coaches, founders, and Learning and Development leaders who already have long-form footage.

## Track record

Twenty plus years in tech, product, research, strategy and experience design, much of it with Fortune 500 teams. The team has worked with CNBC, Raytheon Technologies, JPMorgan Chase, Univision, Bank of Montreal, and Early Riser.

## Stealth product

Beyond services, o1 Labs is building an AI-native product in the health and wellness space. Details to be announced. Interested parties can ask to be notified from the home page.
